title: Oozy Spanish Almond Tarta De Santiago
description: A traditional Spanish dessert featuring a crumbly almond crust and a rich, earthy filling, made with chilled butter and a soffritto base, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, confectioners sugar, and salt.
Add the chilled butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9 inch cazuela.
Bake the crust for 20 minutes, or until it is lightly golden.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, soffritto base, and lemon zest.
Pour the filling into the baked crust and smooth the top.
Bake the tarta for an additional 25 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tarta from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the tarta for at least 2 hours before serving.
